Your signing key

Only this key can make licence keys that PharmaDesk accepts. It stays in this browser. Keep a backup somewhere safe — if it is lost, you cannot make keys for old shops' renewals with the same key.

Backup

Copy the backup text and keep it in your email drafts or a password manager. Anyone with it can make keys, so never share it.

This replaces the signing key on this device.

Dashboard setup (once)

  1. Sign up free at cloudflare.com → Workers & Pages → Create Worker named pharmadesk-admin.
  2. Edit code → paste the worker.js file from PharmaDesk → Deploy.
  3. Storage → KV → create pharmadesk-shops, then bind it to the Worker as SHOPS.
  4. Worker settings → Variables: PUBLIC_KEY = your public key above, ADMIN_TOKEN = a long password (Secret).
  5. Open the Worker address in any browser (Mac, Windows or iPhone) — this same app opens there with your shops.
